text.text: On the northern waterfront, Malé’s back of house, the port, cargo yards and warehouses, occupies the city’s most valuable edge. It blocks the sea and fills the streets with trucks. Fahi-Malé moves the port to Thilafushi and hands the waterfront back to the city.
Fahi-Malé masterplan. Numbers refer to the legend.

Four wings reconnect Malé: to the world through a new arrival terminal, to the ocean through the Ocean Hub, to its past through a breathable old core, and to its future through new homes on the former port land. An amenity core stitches them together. Malé moves up the value chain, from a back-of-house island to a front-of-house city.
